solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

indicators.note: in tells us the abbreviation for right goes inside the word for plunge

parts.note: to plunge is to dive

explanation.surface: A swimmer plunges boldly into the water, showing plenty of energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'displaying' is only a link between the wordplay and the definition at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Drive is vigour or get-up-and-go, a synonym for energy.

definitions.meaning: a body of troops sent off on a particular task
aloofness or lack of emotional involvement

explanation.surface: A unit of soldiers seems not to care.
explanation.definitionFit: A military detachment is a separated unit; detachment also means emotional aloofness.

parts.note: one as the Roman numeral I
M is the abbreviation for married in records
porter is a dark beer much like stout

explanation.surface: A married man took up with a portly trader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stout' reads as an adjective for a fat person but is the noun, a dark beer; PORTER is a close relative.
explanation.definitionFit: An importer is a trader who brings goods in from abroad, one kind of businessman.

clue.text: An outrage otherwise concealed by ill-will

indicators.note: something concealed by another is held within it, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: enmity is hostility or ill-will
or, as in 'do it or else', means otherwise

explanation.surface: Someone's malice hides a shocking scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: An enormity is a grave crime or monstrous wrong, that is, an outrage.

parts.note: reads as preparing drinks, but a gin is also a snare for catching animals, so this is about preparing one to spring

explanation.surface: Someone is about to pour the drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Priming a gin, the animal snare, is the act of laying a snare ready for prey.

clue.text: So hard to get round parts of London or New York

definitions.text: parts of London or New York
definitions.note: plural because there are two districts of the name, one in each city

parts.note: taken as written
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
a round thing is shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Getting around districts of two big cities is so hard.
explanation.walkthrough: Soho is a district of London's West End; SoHo (South of Houston Street) is in Manhattan.
explanation.definitionFit: Soho and SoHo are named districts, one in each of the two cities.

parts.note: a board is a flat panel of wood

explanation.surface: A section of the plane's structure is being described.
explanation.definitionFit: Being aboard means being carried on a ship, train or plane.

clue.text: Politician entering government to screw up

indicators.note: one piece entering another goes inside it

parts.note: rule is government or control
MP, Member of Parliament, is a British politician

explanation.surface: An elected member joins the administration intending to wreck it.
explanation.definitionFit: To screw up paper or cloth is to crumple it, the same as rumple.

definitions.meaning: an old or jokey word for the crown of the head
a savoury paste of meat or fish, spelt with an accent in French

explanation.surface: Someone sets off in search of something to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means the top of the head and, as French paste, a spreadable food.

clue.text: Score with reverse billiards shot? Excellent

indicators.note: reverse tells us the word for the billiards shot is read backwards

parts.note: to pot is to sink a ball in billiards or snooker
to score is to cut a notch, and a notch is also a mark kept as a tally

explanation.surface: A player wins points with a clever backspin shot on the billiard table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reverse' looks like part of the billiards jargon (reverse side) but turns POT round.
explanation.definitionFit: Top-notch is an informal term for first-rate or excellent.

clue.text: More than one tree gets parasitic growth

parts.note: two trees are needed: the oak and the apple
two trees are needed: the oak and the apple

explanation.surface: A grove of trees becomes infested with a parasite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'More than one tree' looks like a plural noun but means two trees side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: An oak apple is a round gall formed on oaks around the larva of a parasitic wasp.

parts.note: refers to the Acts book of the New Testament, recording what Jesus's followers did

explanation.surface: Some famous performers have widely known routines.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible's Acts recounts the deeds of the twelve disciples after the Crucifixion.

clue.text: China, where there's many a crime organisation

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, hence many

indicators.note: organisation means the letters are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: China is a place where a lot of crime is organised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' sits as the country but means porcelain; anagram C, A and CRIME.
explanation.definitionFit: China, the porcelain, is a kind of fired-clay ware or pottery.

clue.text: Capsized oarsman in vessel is in distress

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the vessel

parts.note: a can is a container or vessel

indicators.note: in a down clue, capsized means the word for oarsman is turned upside down

parts.note: a rower is an oarsman

explanation.surface: An overturned rower in his boat is in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capsized' fits the boating picture, but in a down entry it means the oarsman is read from bottom to top (REWOR).
explanation.definitionFit: Careworn describes someone worn and haggard with worry, that is, distressed.

parts.note: a strong hand dealt out at bridge or poker pleases players; the phrase also simply means much

explanation.surface: Card players enjoy something greatly.
explanation.definitionFit: A deal of cards that is a good one pleases players, and the phrase is an idiom for a large amount.

parts.note: 'after all' looks like 'nevertheless' but means after everyone else has arrived

explanation.surface: People who were expected to miss out arrive nonetheless.
explanation.definitionFit: People who arrive behind everybody else are tardy arrivals.

clue.text: Prompt payment may be what archaeologists are looking for

definitions.meaning: settling a bill ahead of time
the remains of an ancient human habitation

explanation.surface: Diggers are hoping for a quick payout.
explanation.definitionFit: Settling a debt soon is paying it promptly; an ancient village is a site diggers seek.

clue.text: Getting tangled up when cleaning out

indicators.note: out, as in put out of order, means the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Things get knotted when you clear out a cupboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Enlacing is winding together or entwining, hence becoming tangled.

definitions.note: a verb form serving as a noun, matching the noun answer

indicators.note: chaos signals that the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A situation erupts into utter disorder.
explanation.definitionFit: An eruption is a violent bursting out, as of a volcano exploding.

parts.note: a grave marker is a final memorial, and the name is also an Arizona town famous for the OK Corral

explanation.surface: A traveller asks about the final memorial in a desert state.
explanation.definitionFit: A grave marker is the last monument to a person, and the same name belongs to a Wild West town.

definitions.meaning: wrap up snugly, as in a scarf

explanation.surface: Advice to stay cosy and hushed.
explanation.definitionFit: To muffle is to wrap up for warmth and also to deaden sound.

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A child asks their mother to pay attention for once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mum' looks like mother but means saying nothing, as in 'keep mum'.
explanation.definitionFit: To be mum is to keep quiet, an informal synonym.

parts.note: reads as the chief of a cleaning staff, but means something that cleans the head of hair

explanation.surface: The senior member of the cleaning staff is introduced.
explanation.definitionFit: A hair wash liquid is used to clean the scalp and hair.

clue.text: Left cat without one vital means of communication

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so these letters go around the next piece

parts.note: a feline is a cat
one as the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A cat abandoned by its owner has lost one of its nine lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' seems to mean lacking, but it means outside: L and FELINE surround I.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifeline is a rope, link or channel on which survival depends.

clue.text: I'd look around for bathing facilities

indicators.note: around tells us the word for look goes about the other piece

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see
taken as written, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone plans to search for a place to swim.
explanation.definitionFit: A lido is a public open-air swimming pool or bathing beach.

parts.note: a den is a private room for work, a study

explanation.surface: An ideal location for studying the English language.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical garden of paradise stands for any ideal place.

clue.text: What dictionaries do about it is quite clear

indicators.note: about tells us the word for what dictionaries do surrounds the other piece

parts.note: dictionaries define words

explanation.surface: What dictionaries say about something is perfectly plain.
explanation.definitionFit: Definite means certain and clearly stated, beyond doubt.

parts.note: overt means done openly
an urn is a vase-like container

explanation.surface: Someone knocks over an uncovered pot.
explanation.definitionFit: To upset something is to knock it over or overturn it.

parts.note: a percussion disc is struck, but in British slang the word also means medals, which nobody strikes

explanation.surface: Some medals are said to be impossible to better.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang a medal or decoration is called a gong.
explanation.definitionFit: Gong is British slang for a medal, while the instrument itself is something beaten.
